title: Allow setting desktop widget geometry using scripting API
line: Desktop scripts can now move and resize widgets on the desktop by setting their geometry.
explanation: Widget.geometry in the desktop scripting API had a setter whose body was commented out since the Plasma 5 port, so assigning it did nothing and gave no error; reading it back returned the old geometry. The containment layout manager had no way to move an existing widget from outside QML. The change adds AppletsLayout.setAppletGeometry(), which moves and resizes the widget's container and places it on the grid the same way a drag does (snapped, nearest free spot, saved to ItemGeometries), and the scripting setter calls it with the rect mapped from the same coordinates the getter returns. Widgets that are not in a desktop layout (panels) now get a script error instead of a silent no-op.

commits.message:
shell/scripting: make widget geometry settable on the desktop

Assigning a widget's geometry from desktop scripts was silently ignored,
as the setter was an empty stub. It now moves and resizes the widget in
the desktop layout, and throws an error for widgets outside the desktop.

BUG: 362511

media.caption: Master: the script adds a clock and sets geometry {x:600, y:300, width:400, height:250}; nothing changes and it reads back 550,364 176x80
With the fix: the same script moves and resizes the clock; it reads back 608,304 400x256 (snapped to the desktop grid)
